FX-WW-001.says: As added: frame 0 is flat water, grey 0.5 everywhere and opaque; then a small ring of ripples spreads from the middle.

FX-WW-002.says: Grid 16 and a ring a quarter wide: the water rises in the middle, then rings spread out.

FX-WW-003.says: Phase 180: the same ripples upside down, dipping first.

FX-WW-005.says: A turned ring, 0.4 by 0.15 at 30 degrees: an oval source.

FX-WW-006.says: A line 0.55 long and 0.2 wide at 20 degrees: waves leave both sides of it.

FX-WW-007.says: Producer 2 switched on (amplitude 0.6, phase 90): two sources whose waves cross.

FX-WW-008.says: Amplitude keyed 0 at frame 0 to 1 at frame 12: the source grows.

FX-WW-009.says: Frequency keyed 0.5 at frame 0 to 3 at frame 18: the source speeds up smoothly, its phase the running sum of the frequency.

FX-WW-010.says: Damping 0.5: the rings fade as they spread.

FX-WW-011.says: Wave speed 0.6: the rings spread faster (more steps a frame).

FX-WW-012.says: A source near the right edge, edges absorbing (none): the waves leave.

FX-WW-013.says: FX-WW-012 with reflect edges all: the waves come back off the edges.

FX-WW-014.says: Frame 40 of FX-WW-002, drawn alone: the same whether or not the frames before it were drawn.

FX-WW-015.says: Pre-roll 0.5 seconds: frame 0 already has ripples.

FX-WW-016.says: Pre-roll 0.5 with amplitude keyed 0.8 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 6: the pre-roll runs on frame 0's amplitude, then the source stops.

FX-WW-017.says: The holder's in point at frame 3: flat there, and frame 15 is FX-WW-002's frame 12 (time counts from the in point).

FX-WW-018.says: The logo as ground, steepness 0.6: the white disc is dry land, drawn level; the waves go round it.

FX-WW-019.says: FX-WW-018 drawing dry areas transparent: the disc is clear.

FX-WW-020.says: The logo as ground, steepness 0.3: all water, slower over the shallow disc.

FX-WW-021.says: FX-WW-020 with transparency 0.8: clearer where shallow.

FX-WW-022.says: Steepness keyed 0 to 0.3 over frames 0 to 12, wave strength 1, no source: the rising ground alone makes waves.

FX-WW-023.says: FX-WW-022 with wave strength 0: no waves, flat grey.

FX-WW-024.says: A ground layer whose in point is frame 4, `late`: read at the holder's in point (frame 0) it is empty, so the ground is flat, as FX-WW-002.

FX-WW-025.says: A ground layer not in the composition, `gone`: flat ground, as FX-WW-002, and the warning.

FX-WW-027.says: Contrast 8: the peaks and troughs clipped to white and black.

FX-WW-029.says: Height 0: every cell dry, drawn level, the brightness everywhere.

FX-WW-030.says: Height 0 drawing dry areas transparent: clear.

FX-WW-031.says: FX-WW-002 on the holder moved 3 right and 1 down: the same, moved.

FX-WW-032.says: Grid 7 (7 by 4 cells): coarse, smooth water.
